appId.description: Package name of the app, for example com.spotify.music.

url.description: Link to the app on Google Play.

developerId.description: ID of the developer on Google Play.

developerEmail.description: Support email the developer publishes on Google Play.

privacyPolicyUrl.description: Link to the app's privacy policy.

genre.description: Main category of the app, for example Health & Fitness.

genreId.description: ID of the main category, for example HEALTH_AND_FITNESS.

categories.description: All categories of the app, each with id and name.

histogram.description: Number of ratings for each star, from 1 to 5.

installs.description: Install range as Google Play shows it, for example 100,000,000+.

minInstalls.description: Lower bound of the install range, as a number.

maxInstalls.description: Google's own, more exact install count.

free.description: True when the app is free to download.

price.description: Price of the app; 0 for free apps.

originalPrice.description: Price before a sale; null when the app is not on sale.

priceText.description: Price as Google Play shows it, for example Free or $4.99.

offersInAppPurchases.description: True when the app sells in-app purchases.

inAppPurchaseRange.description: Price range of the in-app purchases, for example $0.99 - $99.99 per item.

containsAds.description: True when the app shows ads.

contentRating.description: Age rating, for example Everyone or Teen.

contentRatingDescription.description: Reasons for the age rating, for example Mild Fantasy Violence.

releasedText.description: Release date as Google Play shows it.

updatedAt.description: When the app was last updated (ISO date and time).

minAndroidVersion.description: Lowest Android version the app runs on.

recentChanges.description: What's new in the latest update.

playPass.description: True when the app is in Google Play Pass.

preregistration.description: True when the app is open for pre-registration and not released yet.

source.description: How the app was found: search, chart, developer or app (an app ID from the input).

rank.description: Position of the app in the search results or chart, from 1; null for apps found by developer or ID.

searchTerm.description: Search term that found the app; null for other sources.

chart.description: Chart that listed the app, for example topselling_free or topgrossing; null for other sources.

chartCategory.description: Category of the chart, for example GAME; null for other sources.

developerQuery.description: Developer from the input whose apps were listed; null for other sources.

country.description: Country of the store (ISO code), which sets prices and charts.
